text:
Aisha Khatri: Starting this thread to capture the follow-up items from last night's hosted inference 5xx/timeouts incident. Short summary: spike at ~03:14–03:40 UTC, most 5xxs traced to auth-proxy timeout cascades + KV cache cold/warmup causing backlog. We mitigated by routing to fallback model variants and temporarily increasing circuit thresholds.
Samir Patel: thanks Aisha. we recorded a few customer reports of timeouts - support ticket INF-9876. I attached the sampling traces to the ticket.
Ben Cho: quick note — metro egress also hit rate-limits for a subset of clients which amplified retries. adding that to the timeline.
Jordan Reilly: root cause we think is auth-proxy thread starvation when KMS call latency spikes. proxy retries + upstream timeouts produced retry amplification into gateway. KV misses made request path work harder.
Lee Chen: mitigation checklist we ran:
- adjusted proxy retry policy to 2 -> 1
- raised gateway cb threshold for 10m
- pinned fallback routing to smaller model (fast-serve)
- restarted a small subset of proxy instances to shed stuck threads
Samir Patel: all good. customers were notified via support; no billing impacts reported but we should verify retrospective billing logs.
Aisha Khatri: Action items (owner @ due):
- CI-1: Add metric/alert for auth-proxy KMS latency spike (owner: Lee Chen, due: 2026-04-02)
- CI-2: Harden proxy retry/backoff defaults and add jitter (owner: Ben Cho, due: 2026-03-31)
- CI-3: Improve kv-cache warmup in the serving runtime (owner: Jordan Reilly, due: 2026-04-07)
- CI-4: Postmortem writeup and customer comms template (owner: Samir Patel, due: 2026-03-30)
- CI-5: Runbook edit: include 'fallback pin' play and circuit rollback steps (owner: Aisha Khatri, due: 2026-03-29)
Ben Cho: I'll open a PR for the retry/backoff bump — PR #4832. will add tests for no-retry on 401/403 to avoid pointless amplification.
Jordan Reilly: for KV warmup: proposal is to pre-populate commonly-used prefixes during model load; I'll prototype a small warmup thread that runs on scale up. rough patch name: kvcache-warmup-v2.
Lee Chen: alert spec: create an SLO alarm when KMS p95 > 600ms for >3m AND proxy thread utilization > 70%. I'll draft the alert and add to the incident channel.
Samir Patel: regarding customer comms: suggest a short bullet note explaining what happened + what we changed and ETA for longer writeup. I'll coordinate with support to post by EOD PST.
DevRel Bot: Incident log updated: INF-9876 linked to postmortem doc — https://redwood.internal/docs/pm/inf-9876 (placeholder).
Aisha Khatri: Operational follow-ups: schedule a canary for changed retry settings in dedicated staging next week. Also let's run a chaos job to simulate KMS latency spike and validate fallbacks.
Ben Cho: assigned CI-2 to myself, ETA 3/31. marking in JIRA: RED-INF-1024.
Jordan Reilly: assigned CI-3, will create a bench script and share results in this thread when ready.
Lee Chen: assigned CI-1, will post alert PR and link to ops playbook.
Samir Patel: assigned CI-4 and customer comms. I'll post the draft in #support for review.
Aisha Khatri: couple of follow-on risks to track: 1) fallback routing increases token cost for some customers (opt-in?) 2) quantization variants might behave differently under load — add to Optimize team review.
Ben Cho: noted on cost tradeoffs — will include cost delta estimate with PR.
Jordan Reilly: Optimize review pinged (cc @Optimize team).
Lee Chen: any objections to putting a temporary 10m token-level rate cap for a small percent of clients during canary? avoids noisy neighbors during test.
Samir Patel: fine with temporary cap for 5% test cohort. make sure support sees it.
Aisha Khatri: OK. I'll update the postmortem doc with today's decisions and close the loop once all CI items are done. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
DevRel Bot: Reminder: please add the incident tag 'hosted-5xx-timeouts-2026-03' to all related PRs and tickets.
Ben Cho: Will do.
Jordan Reilly: adding a short repro note for the postmortem: sequence-length heavy requests + initial cold KV misses + auth KMS p95 spike -> proxy threads back up -> retries fan-out -> gateway cb trip -> 5xx spike.
Aisha Khatri: Good repro summary. I'll include that in timeline. If anyone has additional telemetry or traces, drop them here and I'll attach to the doc.
Lee Chen: attaching a small log snippet in the ticket:
```
[03:17:02] proxy: KMS call p95=1.2s, threads=92%
[03:17:04] gateway: upstream error 502, cb open
[03:17:05] runtime: kvmiss rate +34%
```
Samir Patel: closing note — we'll do a 15m sync next Tue to ensure progress on CI items. Invite will go out.
Aisha Khatri: Thanks everyone. Thread closed for now; reopen if new customer hits or additional root cause emerges.
